newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds driven higher by Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds driven higher by Bunds.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Bonds rose taking lead from the Bunds which in turn lifted by slightly softer dollar. Market looks set for further gains, traders said. *Sept 97 futures 45 up at 110.96 vs Weds close *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.55 vs 102.10. Yld 6.26 vs 6.32 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 71 bps vs 72 bps
